outcome: rate of elective repeat cesarean delivery (CD)
rate of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) attempt
cohort: 10,791 women (428 adolescents and 10,363 adults) with a history of prior CD presenting for delivery of a second child
finding: While adolescents had a lower overall repeat CD rate and a higher VBAC attempt rate compared to adults, VBAC success rates were similar between the two groups.
mod_finding: Adolescents were more likely to attempt a VBAC than adults (40.42% vs. 30.09%).
